optimization.zh: 优化终端高输出、长会话流式内容、代码高亮、图片与 Artifact 预览的增量处理，提升长时间使用时的响应与资源稳定性。
optimization.en: Improves incremental handling for terminal output, long conversation streams, code highlighting, images, and artifact previews to improve responsiveness and resource stability.

optimization.zh: 优化运行时、会话与后台任务生命周期，降低重复解析、无界队列和残留进程风险。
optimization.en: Improves runtime, session, and background-task lifecycles to reduce duplicate parsing, unbounded queues, and lingering processes.

optimization.zh: 优化自动浏览预览缓存与界面热点，保留用户手动标签并改善导航、面板和输入区域的流畅度。
optimization.en: Improves automatic preview caching and interface hot paths while preserving manually opened tabs and smoothing navigation, panels, and composition.

fix.zh: 修复退出时终端进程组和端口未可靠释放的问题。
fix.en: Fixes terminal process groups and ports not being released reliably on exit.

fix.zh: 修复工作区文件预览中的路径竞态，并加强运行时来源完整性复核。
fix.en: Fixes a workspace file-preview path race and strengthens runtime provenance revalidation.

fix.zh: 修复 Keychain 保存后重启失败及文档元数据失败时状态提示不准确的问题。
fix.en: Fixes inaccurate status reporting when restart fails after Keychain storage or document metadata fails after content is saved.

fix.zh: 修复长会话流可能持续保活、辅助功能标签未随语言更新的问题。
fix.en: Fixes long-running conversation streams retaining state and accessibility labels not following language changes.

fix.zh: 修复中文输入法候选提交内容可能被旧草稿清空的问题。
fix.en: Fixes committed Chinese input-method text being cleared by a stale draft.

fix.zh: 修复短用户消息未按自然宽度贴右显示的问题。
fix.en: Fixes short user messages not using their natural right-aligned width.

fix.zh: 修复上一版本中已确认的问题。
fix.en: Resolves verified issues from the previous version.
